messages:
Maya (sales): Poppy POC kickoff — customer asking for a reference workload run + quote. Needs perf validation: 95th <= 200ms, p99 <= 350ms at 20 qps sustained, with bursts to 80 qps for 30s. Mixed prompts (short 32t, medium 128t, long 512t). KV cache should be on. Can we draft a run plan + approximate cost by EOD Fri? cc @Veronica @Tom

Tom (SE): Got it. Do they want single-region only? Also which model variant? I'll propose a run plan with ramp, sustain, and burst and a k6 script for reproducibility.

Maya (sales): Single-region (us-west1) to start, customer prefers a high-accuracy open model — suggested "redwood-v1-large" (float16) for baseline. They asked about quantized variant if cheaper.

Tom (SE): Plan sketch:
- Warmup 2min at 5 qps
- Ramp 10 -> 20 qps over 3m
- Sustain 20 qps for 15m (measure p50/p95/p99, tail jitter)
- 3 bursts to 80 qps for 30s spaced 2m apart
- Mixed prompt mix: 50% short(32t), 30% med(128t), 20% long(512t)
- KV cache on (prefix-hit 60%)

Include a sample k6 snippet: 
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-v1-large', prompt: '...'}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer $TOKEN'}})
}
```

Tom (SE): For infra: recommend 2x g5.12xlarge-like equivalent (dedicated pool) for the sustained window to avoid noisy neighbors. Batch size 1-2 for low latency, and concurrency tuning at the request router to cap per-GPU inflight to ~40.

Li (eng): FYI: redwood-v1-large float16 hits target latency at 20 qps on that hw with KV cache. Quantized int8 drops cost ~35% but expect ~10–15ms extra 95th latency on long prompts. If customer is strict on 95th <=200ms we should run both and surface tradeoffs. Also note recent kernel bump might affect long prompt p99 by ~20–30ms — will run canary.

Maya (sales): Good note. Can you prepare two runs (float16 baseline, int8 quant) and add cost delta?

Tom (SE): Yep. Quick cost back-of-envelope for hosted vs dedicated (sustained 15m window used to extrapolate):
- Hosted: ~ $0.45 / 1k tokens (est) -> for typical request mix ~ $X/day (will compute precisely once we have token counts)
- Dedicated (reserved): infra amortized + infra ops -> ~ 60% of hosted for sustained loads at >=50% utilization.
(These are rough — I'll run numbers after we collect sample token distribution.)

Maya (sales): Customer also asked about security questionnaire items: where does key management live and can we meet SOC-like audit needs? They sent a short SQ, but we'll handle that separately — just flagging.

Li (eng): For Private/Dedicated: KMS integration available, audit logs retained for 90 days by default (longer retention is an add-on). For hosted, keys managed by Redwood KMS; we can offer customer KMS integration on premium contracts.

Jordan (ops-bot): deploy-bot: Dedicated test pool "poppy-poc-usw1-01" created for this run (2 nodes). Quota reserved for 2h starting 2024-09-01T15:00:00Z.

Maya (sales): Awesome — schedule the runs for Mon 15:00 PT. Veronica, can you confirm customer availability?

Veronica (AE): Confirmed with customer. Mon 15:00 PT works. They'll provide a small sample corpus for token sizing by EOD Fri.

Tom (SE): I'll prepare the runbook and k6 scripts, and post a short checklist:
- Finalize token mix (customer corpus)
- Confirm model variant names and quant flags
- Ensure KV prefix cache dataset uploaded to test cluster
- Start canary run (float16) -> collect metrics -> then int8 run

Maya (sales): If we meet 95th target on float16 and int8 is +10ms, we'll include both options in quote with clear callouts. Also include reserved vs hosted delta.

Li (eng): One more ops caveat: long prompts may trigger memory pressure on 12x GPUs if batch/concurrency set too high. We'll cap per-GPU in-flight tokens, and instrument p95 by sequence length bucket.

Tom (SE): Copy. I'll post final runbook & cost calc in this thread by EOD Fri.

Maya (sales): Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Veronica (AE): :raised_hands:
